description_en: Queries the details of a consumer group for AMQP server-side subscription
description_zh: 调用该接口查询AMQP服务端订阅的消费组详情
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-consumer-group-by-group-id --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --group-id nJRaJPn5U1JITGf000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryConsumerGroupByGroupId

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this ID value is available, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The consumer group ID. This ID is returned after you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170388.html to create a consumer group. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170419.html to query the consumer group ID by consumer group name
parameters.help_zh: 消费组ID。调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170388.html创建消费组成功后，会返回消费组ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170419.html按消费组名称查询消费组ID
parameters.name: group_id
